name: Akahito Tamao
source:
Hobbies: Exercise
Skills: Master of martial arts
Likes: Greasy foods, swimming
Dislikes: Being scolded

A 6th-year student and the newest addition to the Crowns; she works as the general affairs manager. She's a reformed delinquent, so she has a bit of an attitude compared to the other Crowns. Often comes off extremely rude when talking to people, earning herself no ending scolding from [url=/c17298]Saku[/url].

She's a genius when it comes to physical activities, as proved by her mastery of a mysterious ancient Japanese martial art that has been passed down through her family for generations. Tamao is unparalleled and downright invincible in a fight. She doesn't present herself very "nobly" at all, so while there are many who respect her, there are equally as many who fear her. Nevertheless, her behavior has earned her the adoration of many a younger girl, and she's stolen a lot of young maidens' hearts.

Her first impression of [url=/c17297]Shinri[/url] could not have been any worse, and she can't help but snap at him whenever they're in the same room. It's not immediately obvious because of how she comes off to people, but she treasures her friends dearly and is quite overprotective of her fellow Crowns; in fact, she would fight against the entire world for them. Her moderate mounds are nothing to scoff at, but Big Boob Boss Shinri doesn't consider them worth the time of day. She's sworn to totally kick hiss ass for that one day.

"Who're you calling a meathead, huh?! I'll smash your skull open and turn your brain into garden fertilizer!!!"

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
